## Top-Level Layout

```
C:\RadijaAITools/
├── .claude-plugin/          # Plugin manifest + marketplace metadata
│   ├── plugin.json          # Name, version (2.1.4), author, skill discovery path
│   └── marketplace.json     # Marketplace listing description
├── adapters/                # Multi-model adapter configs
│   ├── claude.json          # Claude Code: skill discovery roots
│   ├── codex.json           # Codex CLI: skill path mappings
│   └── antigravity.json     # Antigravity: skill path mappings
├── skills/                  # All 26 skills (each is a directory)
│   ├── ai-radija-grill-me/
│   ├── ai-radija-specify/
│   ├── ai-radija-clarify/
│   ├── ai-radija-plan/
│   ├── ai-radija-tasks/

│   ├── ai-radija-pr-ready/
│   ├── ai-radija-write-a-prd/
│   ├── ai-radija-prd-to-issues/
│   ├── ai-radija-new-feature/
│   ├── ai-radija-analyze/
│   ├── ai-radija-checklist/
│   ├── ai-radija-constitution/
│   ├── ai-radija-generate-pre-knowledge-docs/
│   ├── ai-radija-setup-templates/
│   ├── ai-radija-tracker-setup/
│   ├── ai-radija-tracker-ado/
│   ├── ai-radija-tracker-github/
│   ├── ai-radija-tracker-jira/

│   ├── ai-radija-tracker-notion/
│   ├── ai-radija-tasks-to-issues/
│   ├── ai-radija-write-a-skill/
│   └── ai-radija-bootstrap/
│       ├── SKILL.md
│       └── templates/regulations/  # Country-specific compliance docs
├── templates/               # Default artifact templates (source of truth)
│   ├── spec-template.md
│   ├── plan-template.md
│   ├── tasks-template.md
│   ├── constitution-template.md
│   └── checklist-template.md
├── docs.AI/                 # Pre-knowledge documentation suite (this folder)
├── CLAUDE.md                # Workflow automation + tracker config
├── README.md                # Installation guide + skill overview
├── install.sh               # Bash installer (Codex/Antigravity)
├── install.ps1              # PowerShell installer (Windows)
└── LICENSE                  # MIT
```

## Skill Directory Convention

Each skill follows this structure:
```
skills/<skill-name>/
└── SKILL.md       # Frontmatter (name, description, triggers) + full instructions
```

Some skills (ai-radija-bootstrap) also contain a `templates/` subfolder with supplementary files.

## Entry Points

| Use Case | Entry Point |
|----------|------------|
| Claude Code plugin install | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` |
| Codex/Antigravity install | `install.sh` or `install.ps1` |
| Workflow automation | `CLAUDE.md` (project root) |
| Skill reference | `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` |
| Artifact templates | `templates/*.md` or `specs/.templates/*.md` |
